translations.web: Your memorable sayings are proverbs of ashes. Your defenses are defenses of clay.
translations.bsb: Your maxims are proverbs of ashes; your defenses are defenses of clay.
translations.kjv: Your remembrances are like unto ashes, your bodies to bodies of clay.
translations.asv: Your memorable sayings are proverbs of ashes, Your defences are defences of clay.
